note: relationships[] findings from scripts/check-profiler-relationships.py that a human has reviewed and that need no dossier change. Each id is printed by the checker and hashes the facts behind the finding (both types for a reciprocal pair; slug, counterparty and url for an unregistered source), so editing either side reopens it. These are structural invariants: an entry here is an exception with a written reason, never a loosened rule. Seeded empty at X1 (v04.71r); X2 populates it. Method: repository-information/PROFILER-CROSSREF-CALIBRATION.md → Relationships checker.

accepted.why: Parent/subsidiary — Quanta owns Blattner outright. `portfolio` entered the enum on 2026-09-06 and was considered here, but it still misdescribes this pair: an operating parent's wholly-owned construction subsidiary is not a financial holding. The types actually missing are `parent`/`subsidiary`; `investor`/`other` remains the closest the schema allows, so this accept stands on its own reason rather than on the enum gap.
